summary: The migration planning guide page complies fully with the assigned brief, plan structure, and source research. It methodically establishes operational workflows for legacy data auditing, relational schema mapping, pilot import verification, and system cutover protocols. Each subsection explicitly defines the assigned workflow role, inputs, decisions, records, exception handling, and software evaluation criteria. Labeled illustrative examples are provided, APG auditor guidance is properly contextualized with disclaimers, ICC supplier portal capabilities are correctly treated as pending demonstration items, and unassigned FAQ content is excluded.

glossary.definition: A controlled rehearsal and validation run using a representative sample of legacy supplier records to test data mapping, schema transformations, and import scripts prior to full production migration.
A risk-mitigation deployment protocol where incoming inspections and transactions are logged simultaneously in both legacy and new systems for a defined duration to verify operational consistency.

recordNames: Data mapping specification document detailing field transformations and validation rules
Signed cutover authorization and post-go-live operational support schedule
decisions: Determine which historical supplier quality records warrant migration into the active software database
Map legacy spreadsheet columns to target software schema fields and relational data structures
Validate pilot import accuracy and approve migration script for enterprise execution
Issue final Go/No-Go authorization for production system cutover across all manufacturing plants
